High liver enzymes (such as ALT, AST, ALP, and GGT) indicate that `liver cells are inflamed, stressed, or damaged` , causing them to leak these proteins into the bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF184cpSjQzC8xuAMh2xsYAZG_-JtGB50hs0qqAGEDdPv-82GJjA_963EugfaWaCyQLX9P6ycOcTLjppxKJGNGHb04PdXfu3BNlxymQPu8vPoVEei4nZgFrocamHa9zzVYT9r23pvDjgfVZKsMcXZqdo3i5CUgmhfYiRT81h2NFkUciOMW14vtXRR7oloh)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF14sl5yx4fg5koifvku2f3YL39ceEvNdU01wYFCZgkjVX35b2OAqvKTKMWuTKfGkNFFEa-cjt9XU3zsdhesSWwrsk8xc9dObh-pXCkzgacSiq5EUS0ukDd-bh5buxBRmJ-TpOt52OhkdOzT5ST3504WnOPGdxoSxcVcUMx3VEG6L20yE)

### Common Causes

- **Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD/NAFLD):** Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease—caused by a build-up of fat in the liver and linked to insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, obesity, high cholesterol, or high blood pressure—is one of the most frequent causes.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF1_FEtc7Re0MSiqDNP3P-Wr8JZKWxODzweIGs29kgcy-RAwa6Rqs6hrFqk7PSBXVmmzOcdIA3EUae3gL7p2A1MhOktUpXOnpNcQ0KGb_oREW7qCThlvlblQbiIvnTPKrq3VQe3gWzJ6iewh5EHuwM15Z0zc5QMHHyVeccitSOm76RNU41q2Mn0Yo-1pXbFWUVP4cCot7S9xBOrOYFyo2p9mgH3DbbDIAAihVaYeRJ)
- **Alcohol Use:** Heavy or long-term alcohol consumption, as well as alcoholic hepatitis, can directly injure liver cells.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF184cpSjQzC8xuAMh2xsYAZG_-JtGB50hs0qqAGEDdPv-82GJjA_963EugfaWaCyQLX9P6ycOcTLjppxKJGNGHb04PdXfu3BNlxymQPu8vPoVEei4nZgFrocamHa9zzVYT9r23pvDjgfVZKsMcXZqdo3i5CUgmhfYiRT81h2NFkUciOMW14vtXRR7oloh)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF1_FEtc7Re0MSiqDNP3P-Wr8JZKWxODzweIGs29kgcy-RAwa6Rqs6hrFqk7PSBXVmmzOcdIA3EUae3gL7p2A1MhOktUpXOnpNcQ0KGb_oREW7qCThlvlblQbiIvnTPKrq3VQe3gWzJ6iewh5EHuwM15Z0zc5QMHHyVeccitSOm76RNU41q2Mn0Yo-1pXbFWUVP4cCot7S9xBOrOYFyo2p9mgH3DbbDIAAihVaYeRJ)
- **Medications and Supplements:** Over-the-counter pain relievers (particularly acetaminophen/Tylenol), prescription drugs (such as statins, antibiotics, or mood-disorder medications), and certain herbal remedies or supplements can stress the liver.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF184cpSjQzC8xuAMh2xsYAZG_-JtGB50hs0qqAGEDdPv-82GJjA_963EugfaWaCyQLX9P6ycOcTLjppxKJGNGHb04PdXfu3BNlxymQPu8vPoVEei4nZgFrocamHa9zzVYT9r23pvDjgfVZKsMcXZqdo3i5CUgmhfYiRT81h2NFkUciOMW14vtXRR7oloh)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UVco0M7mpqs&t=59)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzejBONW9Ko&t=60)
- **Viral Hepatitis:** Infections like Hepatitis A, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C cause active inflammation in liver tissue.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF184cpSjQzC8xuAMh2xsYAZG_-JtGB50hs0qqAGEDdPv-82GJjA_963EugfaWaCyQLX9P6ycOcTLjppxKJGNGHb04PdXfu3BNlxymQPu8vPoVEei4nZgFrocamHa9zzVYT9r23pvDjgfVZKsMcXZqdo3i5CUgmhfYiRT81h2NFkUciOMW14vtXRR7oloh)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXX7AKb4_vfPZ4dAv1-BUVr7eLQU93ezsCuMbNuF13mh5Q7aJSWBX0x01rH_urnDS0OoN_waWU3a4nmfAsCkPXc6q_ns_wxccd4R00gjP6C5A-Urouo0t8LaUtlbvFxrcD3rNFsraF-HTrXBtY8Du8s)
- **Autoimmune and Metabolic Conditions:** Conditions such as autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis (PBC), hemochromatosis (excess iron), Wilson's disease (excess copper), or celiac disease can trigger enzyme spikes.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF184cpSjQzC8xuAMh2xsYAZG_-JtGB50hs0qqAGEDdPv-82GJjA_963EugfaWaCyQLX9P6ycOcTLjppxKJGNGHb04PdXfu3BNlxymQPu8vPoVEei4nZgFrocamHa9zzVYT9r23pvDjgfVZKsMcXZqdo3i5CUgmhfYiRT81h2NFkUciOMW14vtXRR7oloh)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwIBxCJF1zHwRzn6K7Ii-0-1rL6sSGzDwjglpIIvpaC0n2jJxOhpILE1CNGfDV_c8KM_fZtATVxTh3xgr_HPRfBNH_xc7h43kepkiGnYQdClyJf2QjyaJkK9UZNm3_giKijWTxmaRkneP9wOI1EUl_XaDTYtBslXbrLFWpXtH-eBaC9745OzXeMDtD1Ahobu3bWys6fLA7zXl_99MG9OW11WvaDe6Rzz7ViQdK4XmBBv29tpfA-fYEt41pi8d2fdHI53r0Y1OnnsbR34v-aCZedHMBPoU08-hcdZ0jxIt1ysWXpyOHgxofNGBq52om0jJ8n-uYlIT4mTTviqiCacmHOH-BA_GM0p-MoKqvJZFMrm5uNOM2v1qxJFTF0YwD9Qmg)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eWqs7c2M-M&t=125)

items.title: Common Causes
items.text: Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD/NAFLD): Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease—caused by a build-up of fat in the liver and linked to insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, obesity, high cholesterol, or high blood pressure—is one of the most frequent causes. Alcohol Use: Heavy or long-term alcohol consumption, as well as alcoholic hepatitis, can directly injure liver cells. Medications and Supplements: Over-the-counter pain relievers (particularly acetaminophen/Tylenol), prescription drugs (such as statins, antibiotics, or mood-disorder medications), and certain herbal remedies or supplements can stress the liver. Viral Hepatitis: Infections like Hepatitis A, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C cause active inflammation in liver tissue. Autoimmune and Metabolic Conditions: Conditions such as autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis (PBC), hemochromatosis (excess iron), Wilson's disease (excess copper), or celiac disease can trigger enzyme spikes. Non-Liver (Extrahepatic) Factors: Strenuous or unfamiliar exercise (which can elevate AST via muscle breakdown), thyroid disorders, celiac disease, or heart failure can also show up as abnormal readings on a liver panel.
